Hilde was at home during the holiday.
In the mornings she took it easy.
sentences.Hun dusjet og vasket håret, spiste lang: She had a shower and washed her hair, ate a long breakfast and read the newspaper.
sentences.Etterpå dro hun på biblioteket eller tra: Afterwards she went to the library or met friends in town.
sentences.Noen ganger jogget hun og ei venninne op: Sometimes she and a friend jogged up to a big park in town, and she also visited a couple of museums and galleries.
sentences.Hilde hadde en fin ferie, uten vekkerklo: Hilde had a lovely holiday, without an alarm clock and without plans.
